Following our discovery last week, the team at Redwood would like to run a compact "Enablement Bootcamp" to accelerate your implementation. Proposed structure:

- Day 2 (Dec 2): SDK / prompt patterns & evaluation playbook (90m)

I'll circulate an agenda and pre-reads tomorrow.
